column1: # unit-464subkind — MY independent evaluation of Daedalus's FIVE ordered hazard criteria, applied
# to the same thirteen CROSS-STATE rows, read off `slice1.13rows.out` (a recorded slice of the
# PINNED source at de422c75), not off his `subkind5`, `reach`, `figure` or `states` columns.
# THIS FILE DELIBERATELY CARRIES NO `subkind5` COLUMN. The grader derives the first-yes label from
# c1..c4 itself and joins his verdict out of HIS file on (file,line,id), so a departure cannot come
# from my transcription of his label. [[feedback_slicing_the_inputs_but_retyping_the_verdict]]
# His criteria, verbatim from HAND-READ-13.tsv, first yes decides:
#   1. are the states never compared TO EACH OTHER (each vs a literal)? -> conjunctive
#   2. does the comparison assert they DIFFER?                          -> delta      (sound)
#   3. is NEITHER side the live worktree?                               -> staleness
#   4. is the compared figure OUT of a cure's reach?                    -> inert
# T / F / ? — `?` means I could not decide it from the slice and is NOT silently folded into F;
# the grader prints the undecidable count and a `?` in a position that would change the first-yes
# label is a REFUSAL, not a result. [[feedback_a_grading_instrument_that_cannot_refuse_manufactures_findings]]
# "out of a cure's reach" is read as out of the reach of THE CURE THE LEG GRADES, not of any

column8: preSrc !== postSrc — the two states are the two operands, and the assertion is that they differ; POST is the LIVE file (comment at :51-54), so one side is the worktree

every conjunct is ONE state's shape-map field vs a boolean literal (!preHas.budget ... && postHas.budget); the states are never an operand pair. c2 is ALSO readable as true (it asserts pre lacks and post has), which is the ambiguity
HIS === pathOf(preSrc,'HIS') compares the states to each other and asserts EQUAL; the figure is the fixture path literal, measured at 0 of 83 changed lines of the graded cure

preCtrlMatches counts live ctrl gate lines against the frozen drive6 lines, element by element — a direct state-vs-state comparison asserting identity; the gate lines are exactly what a cure to the subject moves
five conjuncts, each one state vs an Array/key literal; the bucket set of postDecl is what the graded cure chose (4 -> 3), so the figure is inside its reach
same shape as attrib:71 — six shape-map fields per state, each vs a boolean literal, no operand pair. c2 also readable as true
clonePre === clonePost is an operand pair asserting EQUAL; the figure is the hardcoded clone path, measured at 0 of 77 changed lines of the graded cure
ctrlPinned(preCtrl) is five conjuncts all live-vs-literal, and transition(rec3Arm) === '1→2' is frozen-vs-the-same-literal; the two states are never compared to each other
tripleKey(preCtrl.rows) === tripleKey(rec4Rows) is an operand pair asserting EQUAL; preCtrl is a live run

the predicate is `defectiveShape && atPin !== atRecency` — an explicit !== between the two states, so criterion 2 fires BEFORE criterion 3; atRecency is `git log -1 --format=%h -- HIS_396_PATH`, a recency SELECTOR, so any commit touching the path moves the figure
changed = checkerNow !== checkerThen at :64, refused when NOT changed; checkerNow is the worktree

a === null || b === null — each state vs the literal null, never to each other; HIS_REV comes from sat.json and MY_REV from baseline.rev, so neither side is the worktree AND both anchors are fixed strings, so no cure can change what rev-parse returns at either
a !== b per file is an operand pair, but the LEG refuses when they differ, i.e. it asserts EQUAL, so c2 is false; both anchors fixed as at :79
